summary: Implementation and change-delivery specialist bringing ~7 years of institutional derivatives and fixed-income analytics experience to a Senior Manager, Capital Markets Operations (GWO) mandate. Migrated an entire assigned client book from Calypso to PFaroe: scoping client and platform-configuration requirements, coordinating Technology and Product, and validating outputs post-deployment. Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation at EY across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and PM teams. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation and sensitivity outputs. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.
core_skills: Client & Platform Requirements Scoping and Translation
Output Reconciliation, Validation Testing & Defect Escalation

sections.heading: Change Delivery, Implementation & Readiness
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine covering base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, with configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 to multi-year) supporting funding and refinancing decisions.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls: ran in shadow mode for two cycles, reconciled against legacy output, then cut over on a documented rollback plan.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Testing, Validation & Defect Escalation
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before each production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, reconciling sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates ahead of client delivery.

Held one client release 48 hours to isolate a curve-calibration defect, escalated to product owners and the client's Head of Risk, and tracked remediation upstream, capturing the case in the standing validation test suite.

sections.heading: Governance, Controls & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure and scenario impacts, and acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with clients' Heads of Risk.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform onto PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and Product Owners, translating investment and platform-configuration requirements into scoped development requests and translating development constraints back into investment-team language.
Advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configuration; delivered onboarding on schedule and established a configuration pattern reused across the subsequent migration cohort.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation programs for Canadian and international insurers, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting processes.

Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management functions on milestone delivery and implementation materials, isolating the decisions that required executive sign-off and escalating them.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions; the resulting documentation set was reused across subsequent IFRS 17 engagements.
Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, on a team of three building and validating the model capturing all funding-policy dynamics.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency exposures for international institutional clients.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures.
Presented study findings on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
